records.summary_text:
[CW note] From the CryptoWeeklies video of 27 September 2026.

[2026-09-27_QUANT_SECTOR]  
Video Title: Quant Euphoria Breakout: 3‑Sigma Surge Meets TWAP Gravity Resistance  
Video ID: 7th39PwzGPY  
Quant Euphoria Breakout (QUANT_SECTOR) | Class: EQUITY  

Current Market Structure  
- QNT has surged 12% in the last 24 hours, positioning it in the neutral zone rather than the extreme “art” or “bitcoin” zones.  
- Over the past 30 days, the token has posted a staggering 167% gain, while its 90‑day performance sits at 181% (up from 195% for the broader crypto cohort).  
- The asset resides in the euphoria band of the crypto galaxy, defined by a 90‑day momentum > median; QNT is the top performer in this segment.  
- Moving‑average analysis shows the 20‑week SMA above the 50‑week SMA, which in turn sits above the 200‑week SMA, indicating a bullish trend with low risk‑adjusted volatility.  
- Accumulation risk is moderate (≈11/100 on the gravity scale), yet the 8‑out‑of‑100 moves‑consistency metric signals a fragile breakout profile.

Quantitative Valuation & Gravity  
- The time‑weighted average price (TWAP) baseline for QNT is $75; the current market price is trading at a 129% premium, placing it at risk level six on the gravity model.  
- The regression‑based fair‑value line, derived from 2018‑2020 price action, is currently 300% below the market price, underscoring a significant overvaluation.  
- Congested momentum, measured by a multiplier of 2.48, confirms the asset’s high‑risk, high‑reward status.  
- The DCM model flags a heightened risk level (six) due to the recent rally, while the gravity model assigns a risk of 14/100 versus an average market risk of 60/100.  
- Historical DCA ranges over the last two years spanned 39% to 300%, with the current premium at the upper extreme of that band.

Target Floors & Trap Identifications  
- Machine‑learning forecasts a non‑panic floor around $81; a mean‑reversion scenario within the next 10 weeks would see the price stabilise near this level.  
- The base case projection places the price between the current level and $120, while the bull case extends to a high of $160 (or $230 in a breakout scenario).  
- The bear‑market bottom for the crypto sector was $43; QNT has approached but not breached this floor, with a panic floor estimate of $56.  
- The asset’s gravity risk ranks it 39th among undervalued cryptos, indicating it is at the bottom of the risk spectrum for this cohort.  
- Standard‑deviation bands and the 67/100 normalized risk threshold flag QNT as a potential value trap if the price fails to correct from its current over‑premium position.
